newsitem.title: UK: UK"s Major says prepared to act to curb inflation.
newsitem.headline: UK"s Major says prepared to act to curb inflation.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Wednesday he would not hesitate to act to keep inflation under control.
He said input price pressures were still low and it was possible that Conservative economic policies had "scotched" the threat of high inflation.
But he added: "If and when we thought there was a risk with inflation...we wouldn't hesitate to act to keep inflation under control."

Major was addressing an election campaign news conference in Conservative Central Office just one day before Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Bank of England Governor Eddie George hold their monthly monetary meeting.
A Reuter poll of 21 London-based economists found not one expecting rates to rise this week although most forecast a tightening soon after the May 1 election.
